demoNote: Sample records are fictional. Every insight comes from stored data.
title: Monitoring overview
intro: Understand the conversation. Focus on what needs a response.
transparency: Fictional sample data is labeled. Sentiment is tone; priority is urgency. Analysis provenance is shown on every analyzed mention.
listIntro: Find the signal, inspect the context, decide the next step.
empty: No mentions match the current filters. Clear filters or add a fictional sample below.
toolsIntro: Keep your demo reproducible. These tools work with fictional sample mentions.
footer: Local MVP / Human review required / No automatic publishing
reviewNote: Review recommendations before taking action. Nothing is posted automatically.
rulesNote: Local rules; no model inference is claimed. Recognized historical fallback notices are localized; the original analysis remains available.
formNote: Add a fictional example for the demo. New records are clearly labeled as sample data.
transferNote: Import fictional JSON sample records. Imports are validated as a batch. Export all stored records as JSON or CSV.
fileSize: File must be 1 MB or smaller.
importShape: Expected an object with a "mentions" array.
activityCaption: Published mentions per day (UTC). {{count}} active days.
analyzedCaption: {{count}} analyzed mentions. Sentiment describes tone, not urgency.
actionCaption: {{count}} mentions need a response. {{urgent}} have high or critical priority.
importHttp: Import rejected (HTTP {{status}}). Check field formats and URLs.
invalidJson: Invalid JSON file. Check the file syntax.
network: Unable to reach the local API. Check the backend and try again.
validationUrl: Please enter a valid URL, such as https://example.com/post.
sourceLanguage: Original mention content stays unchanged. Analysis wording follows the selected language.
activityCaption_other: Published mentions per day (UTC). {{formatted}} active days.
analyzedCaption_other: {{formatted}} analyzed mentions. Sentiment describes tone, not urgency.
actionCaption_other: {{formatted}} mentions need a response. {{urgent}} have high or critical priority.
activityCaption_one: Published mentions per day (UTC). {{formatted}} active day.
analyzedCaption_one: {{formatted}} analyzed mention. Sentiment describes tone, not urgency.
actionCaption_one: {{formatted}} mention needs a response. High or critical priority: {{urgent}}.
humanNote: Human analysis; no model inference is claimed.
analysisRules: The stored classification uses English keyword rules, not model inference. Human review is required.
analysisLegacyLlm: This view describes the stored model classification; it does not translate the original model reasoning.
analysisHuman: This view describes the stored human classification; it does not translate the original reasoning.
analysisNeedsAction: The stored analysis flags a need for action.
analysisNoAction: The stored analysis flags no need for action.
analysisFallback: Gemini was unavailable or returned an invalid response; rule-based fallback was used.
analysisSupportAction: Review the support complaint and respond with a concrete next step.
analysisReviewAction: Review the original mention and recommendation before deciding the next steps.
analysisStoredText: Stored analysis wording in the selected language. No new model request.
analysisDerivedText: Localized view of classification fields; not a translation of the original free text. The recommendation is general review guidance.
analysisQuestionAction: Answer the user's question or provide a relevant resource.
